newsitem.title: USA: Burke Industries to issue $100 mln in debt.
newsitem.headline: Burke Industries to issue $100 mln in debt.

text.p: Burke Industries Inc plans to sell $100 million in 10-year senior notes in a 144a private placement via NationsBanc Capital Markets Inc, according to a confidential prospectus obtained by Reuters.
Burke, based in San Jose, Calif., manufactures highly engineered rubber, silicone and vinyl-based products used in commercial and military aircraft.

Proceeds from the offering will be used to finance a recapitalization of the company in connection with its purchase by J.F. Lehman & Co, an Arlington, Va.-based firm which invests in marine and aerospace manufacturing companies.
Following the purchase, J.F. Lehman will own 65 percent of Burke, according to the prospectus.
